bid_number: Informal IFB Repairs for 530-B Sequoia Ln.
title: IFB Repairs for 530-B Sequoia Ln. - Municipal Housing

onscreen_lines.desc: SCOPE OF WORK SUMMARY: The purpose of this project is to rehabilitate the existing premises to meet code standards. Work shall include but is not limited to carpentry, plumbing, electrical, smoke alarms, walk-in shower, windows, tape and float, wall patching, paint, doors not operable and in bad condition replacement. Work shall include, but is not limited to, demolition and removal of debris. This project is approximately 980 square feet building area in size. Property located at 530-B Sequoia Ln., Laredo, Texas 78041. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS: All work shall comply with the Department of Community Development /Municipal Housing general requirements. Work specifications shall comply with all building codes currently adopted by City of Laredo. Contractor shall keep job site clean, safe, and in an orderly manner. Contractor will be solely responsible for obtaining and paying for all required city permits, requests for construction progress inspections, and final inspections of this project. Contractor shall familiarize himself/herself with the scope of the project, existing conditions, and proposed improvements to the project. No additional compensation will be given to the Contractor for failure to visit the job site and familiarize himself/herself with the project as noted above. The Contractor is responsible for the project location as well as his workforce, subcontractors, and all others associated with the work to be performed on the project. The Contractor shall furnish all new materials, where required, which are to match existing materials in size, thickness, texture, finish, design, and value. The Contractor shall be responsible for any damages caused to the Owner’s property during the construction operations. The contractor shall make sure that all existing items and systems in the home, and improvements to be made, are in complete working order upon completion of the project. The Contractor shall provide all necessary labor, materials, and equipment to complete this project. The contractor shall provide a written warranty of one year on all materials and workmanship to the Owner and to the Community Development Department / Municipal Housing upon completion of project. Contractor shall provide all required color samples to the Owner for selection. TEMPORARY SERVICES: Contractor shall provide a portable toilet and trash dumpster/dump truck at the job site prior to starting the project. Failure to provide these services, will result in a change order credit towards the Homeowner, as determined by Community Development / Municipal Housing. REMOVE EXISTING ITEMS: All items removed shall be properly disposed of, remove from site, and hauled to the City of Laredo landfill on a weekly basis by contractor. CARPENTRY: WOOD: CARPENTRY All wood to be used shall be #2 Southern Pine W.W. or better. Ensure all new wood materials are treated. Provide and install all new materials and replace all rotted, damaged, or missing, framing, decking, and all other materials exposed during construction. New materials shall match existing materials in size, color, design, and value. CARPENTRY: WOOD: FACADES AND DOORS Provide labor and materials to replace all outdoor facades included storage room, gabbles and provide new 4x8 -5/16 stucco cement and 1x4 Trim painted and seal matching the same existing color. Provide and install new interior door slab only for bedrooms, bathrooms, closets, pantry’s, with all necessary hardware and the same time paint them. Replace with bifold door as required. Repair any interior door frame for properly door installation. Provide new case open frame with moldings on both sides for kitchen and hallways entrances. CARPENTRY: WOOD: KITCHEN AREA Provide and install new kitchen cabinets Formica. Provide and install all cabinets hinges and drawer slides. Provide labor and materials and add two shelves for kitchen pantry cabinet. Provide labor, preparation and material to paint kitchen cabinets. Provide and install double bowl kitchen sink with faucet, cut offs, supply water hoses and all necessary sewer components. CARPENTRY: CARPORT AND FENCE Provide labor and material to perform carport and roof repairs and paint included block fence. WINDOWS: Provide silicone seal around the window aluminum frame and install ¾ quarter round all over the window perimeter and seal and paint for all windows. Provide and install three vinyl windows 70 ½ x 34 5/8 slider low E insulated. FLOOR COVERING: Provide and install new 12x12 ceramic tile floor for the entire property consisting of 2 bedrooms 1 baths, living room, dining room, hallways, closets, pantry and all other areas that require ceramic tile installation. Provide and install versa bond thin set for ceramic tile layout. Concrete chip required for better tile adhesion. Provide install grout mortar to fill all ceramic tile joints. Provide new 1x4 wood base molding for the entire property and all other areas that require and the same time paint them with enamel oil base paint white. Seal based molding top and bottom. DEMOLITION: Contractor shall remove all old VCT floor, baseboard, outdoor siding, ceramic wall tile where applied exhaust fans and all other areas that required demolition to dispose properly to landfill. EXTERIOR DOORS: Replace (4) exterior door. Provide Labor and materials to remove existing sliding door unit and build rough-in opening to install 3068-metal 9 lites pre-hung unit. The storage provides new metal door with frame and moldings and the same time paint them. Replace with 3’0”-6’8” metal six -panel door pre-hung for main entrance and 2’8”-6’8” six panel pre-hung unit for kitchen area. Provide all necessary locks K/A Kwik set for all doors, included interior-exterior moldings and paint them. Existing doors will be delivered to Thomas warehouse. ELECTRICAL: All electrical work shall be installed by a duly qualified and licensed electrician in the State of Texas, and registered in the City of Laredo. A licensed electrician shall be on the job site at all times during the electrical work. The electrician shall install all electrical work as indicated or required. The electrician shall comply with local utility company requirements and meet N.E.C. and local building codes. HVAC CLOSET: CARPENTRY Provide and install all materials necessary to repair and paint the HVAC closet. Remove existing Return grills and clean properly for new vents installation provide by contractor. Provide and install all ceiling HVAC metal vents as per existing layout. Provide coil wash for existing HVAC system inside and outside units. H.V.A.C.: ELECTRICAL Provide and install two disconnect boxes for the new interior and exterior H.V.A.C. units. LIGHT: ELECTRICAL At bathroom, provide a new exhaust fan vent, and light fixture. Vent through the roof. Provide and install all new electric receptacles, switches, GFCI, and outdoor receptacles with respective covers as per existing layout. Provide and install a new 220V receptacle with plate. LIGHT: ELECTRICAL Interior-Exterior Lamps. Provide and install new ceilings fans (3) three, one 44” for bedroom #1, #2, and one 52” for living room area. (celling fans Must be LED). Provide and install ceiling lamps for Kitchen, hallway’s, Pantry’s, and Outdoor areas. (Lamps must be LED). At kitchen area provide and install new 30” Range hood. Provide labor to remove light fixtures and ceiling fans that do not comply with the existing electrical installation. SMOKE DETECTORS: Provide and install five NON-battery-type smoke detectors 10 years warranty. One in the living room, bedroom #1, bedroom #2, family room, & dining area and two carbon monoxide alarms for entrance and bedrooms hallways. PLUMBING: All plumbing work shall comply with city codes and ordinances. A registered licensed plumber in the State of Texas and the City of Laredo shall install all plumbing work. Provide all necessary connections and cut-off valves. TILED WALK-IN SHOWER: BATHROOM SHOWER: At the hallway bathroom Provide rough-in opening and install a 3-piece ceramic tile shower walls of approx. 36” x 60”. New shower is to be WALK IN SHOWER accessibility. Provide and install 24” lavatory with top. Provide and install bathroom accessories 1-24” towel bar and 1- recess paper holder. Provide and install new medicine cabinet matching existing size. For bathroom cabinet install new hinges and doors knobs. Note: Provide labor and materials to install all necessary blocking to perform this job. WALK IN SHOWER SCOPE OF WORK: Project Description Provide all labor, materials, equipment, and supervision necessary to remove the existing bathtub and provide and install a new walk-in shower complete with waterproofing, plumbing fixtures, and finished surfaces. Provide and install all necessary protection for adjacent finishes before demolition. Provide demolition and removal of the existing bathtub, shower walls, plumbing trim, and dispose of all debris. Provide and install repairs to wall framing and subfloor as required. Provide and install a waterproof shower pan. Provide and install cement backer board and waterproof membrane on all shower walls. Provide and install ceramic or porcelain wall tile and shower floor tile. Provide and install grout, sealants, and waterproof caulking. Provide and install a new shower valve, trim, shower head, and drain assembly. Provide and install grab bars 1-24” and 1-42” please consult with homeowner to determine ideal location foe each grab bars. Provide and install patching, texturing, priming, and painting of adjacent walls affected by construction. Provide final cleaning of the work area and removal of all construction debris. Provide and install 16x24 wall niche. Provide and install wall insulation for bathroom modifications walls. FAUCETS, SINKS AND COMMODE: PLUMBING Provide and install a new elongated commode with new floor flange. Provide and install 24” lavatory sink with top and faucets. All plumbing faucets must be delta brand. Provide and install new kitchen sink with faucet. Provide labor to remove any existing ceramic tile on walls and floors and the same tape perform any repairs include paint. Provide and install new medicine cabinets for bathroom. Provide and install new laundry box with hose bibs. ROUGH IN: PLUMBING Provide and install shower controls no more of 48” inches from the floor. Provide and installation of new, relocations, of existing and re-routing of the existing plumbing and electrical if necessary. FINISHES: Provide labor and materials to prepare all areas to paint property interior and exterior. For interior use acrylic semi-gloss latex finish two coats. (color selection provided by M.H). Frames and molding white enamel oil paint. For new exterior painting use 20-year warranty. Match existing colors. Provide labor and materials to paint all roof facia and eaves matching existing colors. FINISHES: Tape and Float Provide labor and materials to complete all missing sheetrock and complete storage room. Provide tape and float, texture and paint for all new materials matching existing finish. WEATHERIZATION: Provide rubber base caulking around new construction subject to weather filtration. Trim and finish all caulking and sealants that are applied around pipes, gaps, holes, and other exposed surfaces. WARRANTY: The contractor shall provide a written one-year warranty on all materials and workmanship to the owner and to the Department of Community Development/ Municipal Housing upon completion of the project. TURN OVER OF PROJECT: Before turning over project to the Owner and to the Municipal Housing, Contractor shall ensure that the property and home are clean and free of debris. The entire project shall be turned over in a clean, professional, and functional manner. Provide all necessary grounds maintenance to remove all unnecessary vegetation, trees, trim trees and yard maintenance. TIME SCHEDULE: Contractor shall have 30 calendar days to complete the project in its entirety.
